tagline: Turn a research question into a source-backed search plan.
introduction: A research companion for Exa workflows, helping you define searches, inspect evidence and produce traceable comparisons.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Exa? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Design a search
capabilities.description: Define queries and filters from an information need.

capabilities.title: Evaluate retrieved evidence
capabilities.description: Assess a supplied result set for authority, duplication and coverage.

capabilities.title: Plan a cited comparison
capabilities.description: Create a comparison structure that preserves missing evidence.

starterPrompts: Design Exa searches to find primary sources on a narrow technical question, with freshness and domain filters.
Review these search results and tell me which claims are supported and which need a better source.
Create a research table with source URLs, dates, confidence and explicit unknowns.

sources.summary: Official web-search, content retrieval and structured research documentation.
